prior_review.scope: Inherit exact live-B baseline, unchanged dependencies and code-only preservation proofs. Three unchanged C modules and all C helper hashes were rechecked; no C artifact was overwritten.

source_pos_review.scope: Literal source POS projection only; not occurrence morphology or contextual sense adjudication.

checks: D uses fresh release/container/retained-container targets and the same exact live B baseline; C remains immutable and is not treated as production baseline.
Private module aliases isolate D adapter constants and transport destination from C helpers.
D staging replaces only the two explicitly frozen delta modules and checks all inherited C candidate hashes before retaining their bytes.
All C guard checks for module approval, exact mounts/dependencies, data/config/environment preservation, private ports and unchanged routes remain in force.
No remote operation or public promotion was executed by this audit. Stopping the exact owned C canary to release port 8792 is a separately authorized parent operation.
lexical_variants changes only its extraction version and optional literal POS fields, requiring agreement of accepted same-source headword and morphology claims and retaining their proof IDs.
Interlinear reconstructs lexical variants from supporting claims rather than trusting the supplied POS label. Incomplete, inconsistent, unbound and partial-token evidence does not establish the veto.
A conflicting standalone syntax prediction is suppressed without creating a source occurrence parse, importing case/number/tense from dictionary POS, or selecting a contextual gloss.
The lexical check is explicitly not an exhaustive analysis inventory or scholarly certainty claim. Matching syntax remains labeled a prediction.

An exact source-feature consensus can survive contradictory syntax, while retaining conflict and unresolved candidate identity. Final maximal features must be supported by an actual non-machine row and fallback support IDs are source-only.
No syntax window, model, dictionary/corpus artifact, source data, provider prompt, ranking model or public route change is included.

resolved_blocker.finding: Initial D fallback retained all candidate rows and could promote machine-only case/number as source_morphology_consensus. Independently reproduced with source ADJ-only, same-lemma machine ADJ/Nom/Sing and contradictory VERB syntax.
resolved_blocker.resolution: Final f376a30a module retains machine rows in ambiguity checks but requires maximal fallback features to equal a real non-machine source row; support IDs exclude machines. If only a machine supports the extra features, it returns no consensus.
resolved_blocker.regression: Tests cover machine-only added features, equivalent real-source support, and a disagreeing machine alternative.

verification.staged_application_and_guard_suite: 301 passed, 1 nonfunctional pytest import-rewrite warning in 6.72s
verification.method: Loaded exact frozen D bytes into normal backend module identities with deployment-equivalent __file__ roots; all three non-delta modules were verified byte-identical to approved C artifacts.

limits: PASS permits exact-byte upload and private loopback canary testing only, not production promotion or public route changes.
Operational D responses must verify the observed source-adverb versus syntax-verb conflict is suppressed in the running candidate and source proof remains available.
This is a bounded presentation/data-integrity fix, not a general philological accuracy certification.
Public promotion remains a separate parent decision with a candidate-specific receipt; inherited promote code does not itself enforce this textual scope restriction.
